name: workforce
notes: Owns workers, trades, effective-dated pay rates, teams and team memberships. A worker has at most one pay rate and one team on any date; a new open rate or membership ends the previous open one the day before (domain rules in packages/domain/src/workforce). getWorkerRate returns the rate in force and, for a monthly salary, the daily equivalent from the setting workforce.working_days_basis (H-11, default 26 until the owner decides; 0 is treated as not set and the daily equivalent is refused). Leaving needs a leaving date and ends the open rate and membership on it; attendance sheets up to that date must be approved first (attendance.listUnapprovedSheets is implemented by the attendance module, which composition wires in). Supervisors see only workers of their teams through team scopes that follow lab_teams, and never receive pay: rates have their own DTO and permissions. CNIC and bank details are masked to the last 4 characters in lists, in audit entries and for anyone without workforce.worker.manage. Importers: workers, worker_pay_rates, teams, team_members. It records no attendance and computes no wages.
